title: Ball control and movement
outcome: Every player feels welcome and grows confident moving, stopping and changing direction with the ball.

fourCorners.technical: players stop, start and change direction with the ball at their feet
fourCorners.physical: players react quickly to a changing signal with a short burst of movement
fourCorners.psychological: players feel welcome and grow confident trying a new move

coach_cues: Show me how you stop it.

activities.variation: Widen the gates and let players choose a new escape route each round.

progression.note: First half. Coach-managed restarts; rotate the goalkeeper.
Second half, same setup. Switch ends; rotate anyone who hasn't played every role.
